support.metaDescription: Back the Commons Hub's Valley of the Common campaign on Artizen — every $10 Artifact you buy unlocks matching funds.
support.heading: Back the Valley of the Common
support.intro: We're raising funds on Artizen with a community match. Buy a $10 Artifact and every dollar you contribute unlocks an additional dollar from each Fund backing us — while matching funds last.
support.ctaNote: Opens artizen.fund · 100% goes to the project · pay by card or crypto
support.statsFallback: See live totals on the Artizen project page.
support.step1Body: Each Artifact is a $10 open edition. 100% of the price goes straight to the project — Artizen takes no cut.
support.step2Body: Every $1 in Artifact sales unlocks $1 from each Fund backing us, multiplying your impact — while matching funds last.
support.step3Body: The top-selling project in the Fund wins the season's cash prize, so your support helps us climb the leaderboard.
support.teaserHeading: Help fund the Valley of the Common
support.teaserBody: Buy a $10 Artifact and unlock matching funds for the Commons Hub.
